answer: Resist sybils with exclusive calendar-booked interactive audits. Each epoch a random auditor books a live Q&A with every seat on a public ledger calendar; bookings denser than one operator can attend flag a farm. At open the auditor whispers a one-time saffron token the seat must echo. Operators whose mesa of stacked same-hour slots collide, or whose walnut-hard quiz replies share keystroke latency, see those seats merge into one reward share.
